rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 327 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (geopolitics led 11-21, policy_regulation led 11-22, so elections_public_opinion leads today, then geopolitics, then policy_regulation); within each group the list starts at offset 327 % group_size in pool order (elections 327 % 9 = 3: AI disinformation first; geopolitics 327 % 10 = 7: 반도체 수출규제 first; policy 327 % 15 = 12: AI 기본법 first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds and agency press pages over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-22, so items published 11-22 (after the prior harvest) through 11-23 are in scope. Context: Monday 11-23 in Korea / Sunday 11-22 in the US and EU at harvest time. Korean ministries (과기정통부, 개인정보위, 선관위, 문체부, 산업부, 국무총리실) release Monday-morning 보도자료 — Korea is the highest-yield jurisdiction today; US/EU yield is Sunday wire reporting of official actions plus any late-Friday/Saturday filings not yet harvested. Taiwan local elections are Saturday 11-28: CEC/MJIB/MODA/NSB official counts, indictments or takedown orders on AI deepfakes in the final pre-election week are high-value, but the Puma Shen deepfake indictment (11-22) and the ~2,700 Threads accounts (11-21) are already covered — only NEW cases/counts/orders qualify. Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: Trump's spoken 'tremendous tax' on offshore AI data centers (covered 11-22; only a written EO, Treasury/USTR action, fact sheet or bill text is new); Trump–Xi–Putin summit (11-20) — a written joint statement or White House fact sheet on AI (incl. the human-in-the-loop military AI claim covered 11-21) is new, commentary is not; House China Select/Homeland report on US firms using Chinese open-weight models (covered 11-22; only a subpoena, bill, Commerce/BIS action or company formal response is new); CCW decision extending LAWS talks to 2028 (covered 11-22 via POLITICO; the official UNODA final-document text alone is the SAME story — skip unless it reveals a new decision); 청와대 '시험 공정성 회복 TF' (covered 11-22; only an official AI-cheating count with action, a filed 특별법 with 의안번호, or police charges are new); Nvidia California AG subpoena (Huang testimony Dec 1 — skip previews). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
